# Stapled super funds for employers
How to request stapled super fund details for new employees who don't choose a super fund.

## On this page
- [If you haven’t made a request when you should](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers/setting-up-super-for-your-business/offer-employees-a-choice-of-super-fund/stapled-super-funds-for-employers#ato-Ifyouhaventmadearequestwhenyoushould)

## When to request stapled super fund details
### If your employee started working for you after 1 November 2021
- they are not eligible to choose a super fund.

### If your employee started working for you before 1 November 2021
You can pay super into their chosen fund, or your employer default super fund if there is no valid chosen fund.

## Before you request stapled super fund details
### Offer your employees a choice of super fund
If your employee doesn't choose a super fund, you need to request their stapled super fund details from us.

## Request stapled super fund details
### ATO online services
- stapled super fund we provide in our response to your request if they haven't chosen a fund
- employer default fund if the employee hasn't chosen a fund and there is no stapled fund.

# Paying super for a new employee or fund
## On this page
- [Provide the employee's TFN to their super fund](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers/paying-super-on-payday/paying-super-for-a-new-employee-or-fund#ato-ProvidetheemployeesTFNtotheirsuperfund)

## Identify the super fund to pay into
If the employee doesn't choose a fund, you can ask us (through ATO online services) for details of their stapled super fund.

If we advise you that the employee doesn't have a stapled super fund, and they haven't provided a chosen fund, you pay their contributions to your default fund.

web.description:
# Offer employees a choice of super fund
## Employee has not provided fund details
- your employer default fund (if we advise you that your employee does not have a stapled super fund).

You can request your employee's stapled super fund details from us via ATO online services. For new employees, you can make a request once they accept the offer of employment and until they choose their own fund.

You will also need to request stapled super fund details for employees who aren't eligible to choose their own fund, including:

If the employee started with you before 1 November 2021, you're not required to pay their super into a stapled super fund. You can pay to your employer default fund (or another fund that meets the choice of fund rules).
